ruleLine: Five contracts, each played once per kingdom / the dominoes build out from the JACK
landscapeBanner: Turn your device sideways for a better view
hint.choose: a contract you have not played yet
tutorial.contracts: There are five contracts and the king picks one they have not played yet. Four are penalties; only the dominoes pay out.
tutorial.kingdom: Whoever is dealt the seven of hearts is the first king. After five contracts the kingdom passes on, and the game runs twenty deals.
tutorial.dominoes: The dominoes build out from the JACK, not the seven, one run per suit. If you cannot play you pass, and going out first pays +200/+150/+100/+50.
tutorial.score: The 500 in penalties and the 500 the dominoes pay out cancel, so all four scores sum to zero. The highest total wins.
